title: Microsoft 365 Copilot connectors: delete schema properties with the connector APIs
summary: The roadmap facts and existing schema-management routes are supported, and targeted searches found no documented property-deletion operation. Correct the unsupported description of API use as manual, flag the admin schema documentation as preview, and name the schema request-body property in the control note.

claims.quote: We’re adding support for property deletion in custom Copilot connectors, giving admins and developers more control over schema evolution.

claims.claim: The planned capability uses Copilot connector APIs to delete individual schema properties.
claims.quote: Use Copilot connector APIs to delete or drop individual schema properties that are no longer needed.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes keeping the schema current without full re-ingestion.
claims.quote: Keep your connector schema clean and up-to-date without requiring full re-ingestion.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; controls[0].note; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn does not yet document an operation for deleting an individual custom-connector schema property.
claims.quote: Searched: externalConnectors schema delete property; Copilot connectors delete drop schema property API deletion existing ingested values permissions. Read manage-schema, Update schema and beta schema resource; methods are Create, Get and Update, with no property-deletion operation.

claims.claim: The existing admin schema route is Customization > Schema > Copilot connectors schema > View details > connection > Customize schema.
claims.quote: go to the Schema page in the Customization section. ... Select View details under Copilot connectors schema. ... Select the connection for which you want to update the schema and select Customize schema.

claims.claim: PATCH /beta/external/connections/{connectionId}/schema updates a connection's schema.
claims.quote: Update the properties of a schema for an externalConnection. ... PATCH https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/external/connections/contosohr/schema ... supply a JSON representation of a schema object.
claims.fix: Add to controls[0].note and the rendered note: 'The request body sets properties and requires baseType to be microsoft.graph.externalItem.' The beta reference documents both fields.

claims.where: controls[0].note; What's changing; Why it matters; Governance controls
claims.claim: The admin search-schema update documentation concerns Microsoft-built connectors, not the custom-connector deletion capability.
claims.quote: This section includes information about the update capabilities for the search schema of Microsoft built connectors.

claims.where: controls[0].note; What's changing; Why it matters; Governance controls
claims.claim: For Microsoft-built published connections, the documented way to remove an existing property is to delete and recreate the connection.
claims.quote: You cannot delete an existing property for a published connection. To remove a property, you must delete and recreate a connection.
claims.fix: Qualify the first discussion of this limitation and controls[0].note with 'The Manage search schema documentation is marked preview.' Keep the Microsoft-built connector qualification.

claims.quote: Add or remove a search capability ... You can modify search attributes for a property.

claims.claim: Learn lists adding or removing an alias as a schema update capability.

claims.claim: Learn recommends reindexing after a schema update.

claims.claim: Adding or removing a search capability requires reingestion.

claims.quote: The connection schema defines how your content is used across Microsoft 365 Copilot experiences. A schema is a flat list of all the properties you plan to add to the connection.
